label: Two-world represented KD45 assent witnesses the actual-access omission (inference)
rule: Explicit two-world Kripke countermodel with one selected alternative
meaning: Supply a classified bearer and an unconstrained assent relation accepting every Prop. The same frame selects only the nonactual alternative. Each p is represented by the event holding there or when p is true. False is assented to and its representing event is false at actuality. The proof gives no claim about the possibility of such a divine subject.
